name: smwgraphics-wacky-worlds-creativity-studio-space
title: Wacky Worlds Creativity Studio - Space
description:
BG comes from the space area of Wacky World Creativity Studio for the Sega Genesis/Megadrive.

Uses GFX from BG1, BG2 and a little over half of BG3 and 1 Map16 page and 13 other tiles.

Palette is organised.

Have fun!
